films.ov: An impassioned three-part documentary of the liberation struggle waged throughout Latin America, using Argentina as a historical example of the imperialist exploitation of the continent. Part II: An Act For Liberation examines the ten-year reign of Juan Perón (1945-55) and the activities of the Peronist movement after his fall from power. Part III: Violence and Liberation studies the role of violence in the national liberation process and constitutes a call for action.

films.ov: During the Cold War, the World Chess Championship clashed complete opposites - personal and political.

richarddembo.desc: A French director whose first feature, Dangerous Moves, sets a Cold War chess championship in Geneva; it was entered for the Oscar by Switzerland.
richarddembo.sig: Directed Dangerous Moves, about a world chess championship.
facts: Michel Piccoli plays the Soviet champion.
The film is loosely inspired by the Karpov–Korchnoi matches.
lists: Won the Oscar for international feature with Dangerous Moves (1984).
